reuse.reason: The pinned official packages have no site identity, SEO, discovery-file, analytics or deployment-wide site administrator editor. Mounting or forking the shell/settings feature would retain unrelated Host configuration namespaces and would not supply this site-document contract. This plugin mounts the public plugins.bundle.config and plugins.row.config slots unchanged and reuses the stable SettingsForm, SettingsValueField, Button and Switch primitives. Capability scopes edit the same administrator-authorized CAS document without new navigation. No official implementation is copied or forked. Native enum controls reuse the exported official ModelsSection input/selectInput styles because stable primitives do not export a select field; the model settings feature itself owns unrelated provider state and is not mounted as a site editor. The regression test consumes the exported official rowConfigKey helper to verify the keyed registration contract against the pin.
gaps: User-approved site capability editors: the pinned official plugins have no SaaS site SEO, sitemap, robots, manifest, llms.txt or Google Analytics settings namespace. New schema-specific fields appear inside the unchanged official bundle and row configuration sections; the official detail layout and save/read-only controls remain in use. Each row shows only its capability fields, with a compatible complete-document bundle editor.

The stable value-field primitive only renders a single-line input. Multi-line text/list fields reuse its exported CSS; native selects reuse the exported ModelsSection input/selectInput variant, preserving official arrow spacing, sizing, focus and disabled styling. No upload workflow is provided. Re-audit these source exports when the upstream pin changes.
